title: 1994 AMC 8 Problem 1
statement: Which of the following is the largest?

solutions.text:
Over the common denominator \(24\), the fractions are \(\dfrac{8}{24},\) \(\dfrac{6}{24},\) \(\dfrac{9}{24},\) \(\dfrac{10}{24},\) and \(\dfrac{7}{24}.\)

The largest numerator is \(10\), so \(\dfrac{5}{12} = \dfrac{10}{24}\) is the largest.

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: Rewrite all five fractions over one common denominator
The least common denominator of these fractions is \(24\)
